metadata.article_title: Exposure and abandonment of senior citizen.

article.title: Exposure and abandonment of senior citizen.
article.content: Whoever, having the care or protection of senior citizen leaves, such senior citizen in any place with the intention of wholly abandoning such senior citizen, shall be punishable with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months or fine which may extend to five thousands rupees or with both.
article.html:
24Exposure and abandonment of senior citizen.

Section 24 · Chapter VI · page 8 of the Act

Whoever, having the care or protection of senior citizen leaves, such senior citizen in any place with the intention of wholly abandoning such senior citizen, shall be punishable with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months or fine which may extend to five thousands rupees or with both.
